text: Signed-off by: [any of: name, company, x, linkedin, etc] Written by the speakers and attendees of AIE Code Summit 2026 In 2001, 17 software engineers and leaders got together at a ski lodge in Snowbird, Utah to understand the biggest challenge of their time: heavyweight, documentation-driven software development processes. Out of this we got the Agile Manifesto , four values and twelve principles that changed how most of the industry builds software. Today we convene to build our own manifesto - the No AI Slop manifesto. AI increasingly helps us write our code, docs, plans, and messages. We've all been on the receiving end of slop, and most of us have sent some too. Through this work, we have come to value: Outcomes over output Understanding over speed Our own thinking over a model's first draft Better work over easier work Improving the system over patching the output The world moves especially fast these days, but the goal of these resolutions is to embrace our important human role in harnessing AI safely, responsibly, in a way that creates value for everyone, and that will be relevant for years to come.
